A FEW QUICK ANSWERS

Curious?
We’re listening.

Here are a few things people often want to know before ordering or joining as a baker.

🍰
What is Slicey?

Slicey helps cake lovers discover local home bakers, place cake orders, and follow order progress. Home bakers can use the app to share a menu and manage incoming orders.

Can I customize a cake?

The app previews show options such as cake size, a message on the cake, and a delivery date and time slot. Available choices depend on the baker and the cake you select.

How do I know where my order is?

Open your order in the app to see its current status. The baker updates the order as it moves through stages such as confirmed, baking, and delivery.

I bake at home. Can I join?

Slicey is designed to help home bakers list cakes, manage availability, and handle orders. Use the app’s baker experience to get started, subject to the platform’s onboarding requirements.

Where is Slicey available?

Available bakeries depend on the delivery address and the service area enabled in the app. Check the app to see what is currently available near you.
